query_text: what is a good title for a poem I'm writing about a religious boy who has been sheltered from the outside world by his family, but one day he leaves his house and sees the reality of the world?

content.text:
Here are some title ideas for your poem, playing with themes of innocence, faith, awakening, and the contrast between a sheltered life and the harsh reality of the world:

---

### 🕊️ **Innocence & Awakening**
1. **"Beyond the Garden Wall"** – A metaphor for leaving paradise/innocence
2. **"First Light"** – The first time he truly "sees"
3. **"The Unveiled World"** – Reality being uncovered before his eyes
4. **"Eyes Newly Opened"** – A play on spiritual and literal sight
5. **"Outside Eden"** – Referencing the Biblical fall from innocence

---

### ✝️ **Faith & Doubt**
6. **"Cracks in the Stained Glass"** – His religious worldview beginning to fracture
7. **"The Unanswered Prayer"** – Reality doesn't match what he was taught
8. **"God and the Gutter"** – The contrast between heaven and earthly suffering
9. **"What the Scripture Never Said"** – The world his faith didn't prepare him for
10. **"Between Amen and the Street"** – The gap between religion and real life

---

### 🚪 **Thresholds & Journeys**
11. **"The Open Door"** – Simple but powerful symbol of crossing over
12. **"One Step Past the Porch"** – The moment he ventures out
13. **"The World at the Gate"** – Reality waiting just outside
14. **"Crossing the Threshold"** – A classic coming-of-age metaphor
15. **"The Road He Never Knew"** – A journey into the unknown

---

### 🌍 **Disillusionment & Reality**
16. **"The World as It Is"** – Blunt and powerful
17. **"Dust on Holy Ground"** – The sacred meeting the profane
18. **"The Fall of the Familiar"** – His comfortable world crumbling
19. **"Unfiltered"** – Raw and modern — the world without his family's filter
20. **"A Rude Revelation"** – The jarring truth of what's outside

---

My personal top picks would be **"Cracks in the Stained Glass"**, **"Outside Eden"**, or **"Dust on Holy Ground"** — they all beautifully capture the tension between religious sheltering and worldly reality. Good luck with your poem! 🖊️
